body:
Latest TUNGSTEN files sent: TUNGSTEN_10.52_A7.5_QUANT_SLS(138).mq4, its compiled .ex4, and the full forge_ledger.json (pass_131-139).

WHAT THIS SESSION SOLVED (WARRANT#153-156, all compiled 0/0, diff-verified, deployed md5-identical to all 3 EA locations):

- WARRANT#153: g_PRI[6].armedWithBest only ever set true via Phase 6's degraded/retry arm paths -- a calibration that passed every gate cleanly on its FIRST try never touched it, so compounding eligibility was backwards: a perfect calibration was permanently locked out, a worse best-effort-armed one wasn't. Fixed with a proper 'armed' flag set at the true convergence point.

- WARRANT#154+155: Layer 2 (instrument/broker independence) -- never audited this whole campaign. 5 sites of hardcoded 4-5-digit-FX-scale constants treating raw ATR/MACD as universal across instruments. Worst one saturated on ANY instrument, not just gold -- a structural bug, not a tuning mismatch. Fixed by reusing an ATR-relative convention already established elsewhere in the file.

- WARRANT#156: g_CATREC_Active (the catastrophic-escalation re-entry guard) was declared+read but NEVER written anywhere in 60k lines -- the escalation was re-firing every call and thrashing calibration-trust resets whenever 4+ regimes stayed quarantined. Fixed by hooking the existing lifecycle.

Plus 6 confirmed-clean verification passes (ratchet non-regression doctrine, Living-Edge inversion-trim power floor, a full sweep of all 31 forward-declared functions for dead-call bugs) -- no defects, architecturally-central systems confirmed sound under adversarial re-reading.

Full session checkpoint also saved (.checkpoint in the mailbox repo). Market closed all weekend -- confirmed clean Friday shutdown, not a bug. Next real lever is Monday's reopen, not more static passes.
